purpose: Public product and usability research; no investment recommendation or profitability ranking.
sampling: Purposive English-language public MT5 listings; 12 products, not a representative census.
evidence_policy: Public metadata and short authored notes only. Web responses may be cached; access date is retrieval date, not a certification of live inventory.

excluded_candidate.reason: AI Gold Trader appeared in search but direct open redirected to MT5 Experts category; excluded from 12-product sample.

platform_sources.verified_platform_fact: I.9-10 and V.1-8: automatic formal testing is not a profitability or error-free-operation guarantee; paid EA demos trade only in Strategy Tester and indicator demos use visual testing. IV.6-10 restrict external licensing, personal-data collection, duplicate products and off-site support links.
MetaQuotes describes checks for funds, volume, pending-order/lot limits, stops/freeze levels, insufficient history, runtime errors and CPU/memory use.

WebRequest needs URL allowlisting, is synchronous, is callable from EAs/scripts rather than indicators, and cannot execute in Strategy Tester. This does not establish which transport a product actually uses.
